title: GitHub Copilot có thể viết code thay bạn — nhưng đây là điều họ không nói
script: GitHub Copilot viết code tự động. Nó tiết kiệm developers 55% thời gian code. Nhưng có một sự thật không ai nói: Copilot cũng tạo ra code có lỗ hổng bảo mật nghiêm trọng. Một nghiên cứu từ Stanford chỉ ra rằng developers dùng AI assist có tỷ lệ bug cao hơn 41%. Không phải AI dở — mà là sự phụ thuộc quá mức. Dùng Copilot nhưng phải hiểu code bạn viết. Đây là cách dùng AI đúng cách.
prompt_for_hailuo: Developer writing code at night, green terminal lines glowing on face [Close up on typing]. Glowing green AI code suggestions appearing on screen, some characters highlighted in red as warning [Screen close up]. Matrix-style code rain flowing down in background [Wide atmospheric shot]. Green skull or warning symbol materializing from red-highlighted code sections [Close up warning]. Dark hacker room, green terminal glow, red warning accents, Matrix aesthetic, cyberpunk atmosphere, 9:16 portrait.
thumbnail_idea: Developer face lit by green terminal glow, Matrix code rain, red warning accents
visual_scene: A developer sits in a dark hacker room at night, green terminal lines of code reflecting on their concentrated face. Close up on their hands rapidly typing — the rhythm of a skilled coder. On the screen, glowing green AI code suggestions appear in real-time, Copilot autocompleting functions. Some characters and code sections are highlighted in urgent red as warning indicators. Screen close up shows the dangerous code paths pulsing red. Matrix-style green code rain flows down in the background, creating depth. From the red-highlighted code sections, a glowing red warning symbol and green skull materialize — representing the security threat. Wide atmospheric shot pulls back to show the full dark hacker room with multiple monitors, green glow, and red warning pulses. Portrait 9:16 framing throughout.
negative_prompt: generic anime or cartoon style, animated characters, distorted hands or fingers, blurry or low resolution output, text overlays or captions, logos or watermarks, still or static frame, landscape orientation, bright daylight scene, sunny outdoor setting, warm cozy home interior, cartoon cute robot design
specific_details: Developer in dark hacker room at night, green terminal glow reflecting on face, AI code suggestions appearing in green with red warning highlights on dangerous sections, Matrix-style green code rain flowing in background, red warning symbols materializing from vulnerable code sections, green skull security threat visualization, cyberpunk atmosphere, portrait 9:16.
